Jacob.blurb: I saw this with Joey and Greg at a series called Strange Hours hosted by the Heights Theater. It has a great heart and sense of purpose imo. The use of the "Eton Boating Song" in the start and end credits is perfect. While a lot of people go just for the final act, I actually think it's a tad overrated. The slow burn build in the first two acts is what does it for me.
